Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the problem by failing to recognize that "Slim Carter" and "Thendral Veesum" are film titles and not directors themselves. The Planner incorrectly instructed subsequent agents to search for directors named "Slim Carter" and "Thendral Veesum," leading to unnecessary confusion and redundant searches. The correct approach would have been to directly identify the directors of the two films (Richard Bartlett and B. S. Ranga) from the outset and compare their birth dates.
